meta.name: do
meta.description: Execute a phased implementation plan using subagents. Use when asked to execute, run, or carry out a plan — especially one created by make-plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用子智能体自动执行分阶段计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果已有分步计划需要自动执行
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a step-by-step plan to execute automatically

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 变成编排者:它派出子代理执行计划里的每个阶段,自己只做协调、分派上下文并核对子代理是否完成清单。每阶段有实现、验证、反模式检查与代码质量审查,只有验证通过才提交。
howto.when: 当你要求执行、运行或落实某个计划时触发,尤其是由 make-plan 生成的计划。

say.text: 按这个计划开始执行,每个阶段完成后先验证再提交
say.note: 会派出子代理逐阶段推进

say.text: 执行计划的第 2 阶段,完成后跑验证清单
say.note: 拿到该阶段的实现与验证结果

say.text: 这一阶段验证通过后,提交到工作分支
say.note: 仅在验证通过后才会提交

howto.what_en: Claude becomes an orchestrator: it deploys subagents to execute each phase of your plan, coordinating rather than doing the work itself. Each phase gets implementation, verification and code review checks; commits only after verification passes.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to execute, run or carry out a plan, especially one created by make-plan.

say_en.text: Execute this plan, verifying each phase before committing
Run phase 2 of the plan and its verification checklist
say_en.note: Get that phase's implementation and proof

say_en.text: Commit this phase to the working branch once it passes
